title: nuikit compiled theme (tokens v2: the token language)
description: What compileTheme() returns and the nuikit resource publishes: every token, lowered so FiveM's browser can read it.

card.description: Raised blocks on a full-screen surface

primary.description: The one main action per surface, the keycap face, selection

muted.description: Tracks, slots and wells inside a panel

radius.description: The radius scale's base: every radius step derives from it

font-display.description: Anything scanned: keys, titles, labels, captions (the body face unless a theme says otherwise)

font-mono.description: Codes and IDs a player might type

nk-height-control.description: Buttons and bar items / large glyph

nk-height-field.description: Text inputs, selects and dialog buttons

nk-icon-stroke.description: Stroke width of every icon (Hugeicons draw at 1.5)

nk-text-base.description: Body size; every step derives from it

nk-text-figure.description: A number that is the point (the figure style); a component re-points it for its size

nk-text-row.description: A row or notice title (the label voice)

nk-text-desc.description: A row or notice description (the body voice)

nk-leading-title.description: Titles and sections (a ratio of the size)

nk-leading-display.description: Full-screen titles and HUD values (a ratio of the size)

nk-leading-figure.description: A number that is the point: a clock, a balance, the speed (a ratio of the size)

nk-shape-skew.description: The slant of faces (keys, the primary button, the selection; boxes and text stay upright): 0 = upright, at most ±20deg

nk-shape-slab.description: Chips, badges and tags drawn as skewed slabs too (0deg = upright); at most ±20deg

nk-shape-cut.description: Chamfered corners (top left, bottom right) as clip-path; 0 = off

nk-shape-stroke.description: Hairline weight of plates, rims and fields

nk-type-ratio.description: Step between type sizes: 1.125 calm … 1.333 dramatic

nk-type-weight-strong.description: Captions, chips, slabs: text that must hold its own on the game

nk-type-case.description: Anything scanned (keys, titles, labels, captions) in caps or as written

nk-type-slant.description: The scanned voices upright or italic (a real italic where the face has one)

nk-type-overhang.description: Trailing pad of a slanted voice (the italic's overhang); 0em when upright

nk-type-overhang-clip.description: How far a clipped text window (TextRoll, a reel) reaches past its text on each side: twice the overhang, since a heavy slanted cap leans further than its trailing pad, plus a hair for antialiasing

nk-type-scan-family.description: Face of the scan voice (keys, buttons, tabs)

nk-type-scan-style.description: Slant of the scan voice (keys, buttons, tabs)

nk-type-scan-weight.description: Weight of the scan voice (keys, buttons, tabs)

nk-type-scan-tracking.description: Letter-spacing of the scan voice (keys, buttons, tabs)

nk-type-scan-case.description: Case of the scan voice (keys, buttons, tabs)

nk-type-scan-pad.description: Trailing pad of the scan voice (keys, buttons, tabs) (the italic overhang)

nk-type-title-family.description: Face of the title voice (panel and row titles)

nk-type-title-style.description: Slant of the title voice (panel and row titles)

nk-type-title-weight.description: Weight of the title voice (panel and row titles)

nk-type-title-tracking.description: Letter-spacing of the title voice (panel and row titles)

nk-type-title-case.description: Case of the title voice (panel and row titles)

nk-type-title-pad.description: Trailing pad of the title voice (panel and row titles) (the italic overhang)

nk-type-label-family.description: Face of the label voice (labels, row titles)

nk-type-label-style.description: Slant of the label voice (labels, row titles)

nk-type-label-weight.description: Weight of the label voice (labels, row titles)

nk-type-label-tracking.description: Letter-spacing of the label voice (labels, row titles)

nk-type-label-case.description: Case of the label voice (labels, row titles)

nk-type-label-pad.description: Trailing pad of the label voice (labels, row titles) (the italic overhang)

nk-type-num-pad.description: Trailing pad of the numeric voice (the italic overhang)

nk-surface-tint.description: How much brand tints neutral surfaces

nk-surface-elevation.description: Shadow recipe: hard is a solid offset drop, no blur

nk-surface-glow.description: Brand glow on active parts (alpha, 0 = off)

nk-surface-glow-budget.description: How many parts may glow at once (0 = no limit)

nk-surface-backdrop.description: Backdrop blur (FiveM draws it as a black box: off)

nk-surface-legibility.description: day lifts surfaces for a bright sky; auto follows the game clock

nk-surface-legibility-lift.description: How far day closes the gap to opaque

nk-surface-slash.description: A decorative diagonal cut on menus

nk-material-menu-opacity.description: Opacity of the menu material (floor 0.92 for text)

nk-material-menu-blur.description: Backdrop blur behind menus (with surface.backdrop on)

nk-material-menu-radius.description: Corner radius of menus, sheets and dialogs

nk-material-menu-edge.description: The machined top edge of menus (alpha)

nk-hud-text.description: Shadow under text drawn on the game (semantic depth.text draws it)

nk-motion.description: 1 = animations on, 0 = off (painted 0 under the player's reduced-motion pref)

nk-motion-duration.description: Base duration d: the ladder is snap 0.5d, fast 0.667d, base d, slow 1.556d, fill 2.333d

nk-motion-feel.description: How it moves: crisp, snap (flash instead of press scale), smooth (longer springs), stepped

nk-motion-bounce.description: Bounce folded into the snap, move and soft springs

nk-motion-exit-factor.description: Every exit is this × its enter

nk-motion-reduced.description: Under reduced motion every fade is at most this

nk-motion-profile.description: full: as designed; reduced: no movement, short fades; instant: nothing animates

nk-style-fill.description: Fills, the selection face and levels: solid (flat, vivid) or soft (a tint)

nk-style-level.description: How a level (0–1) is drawn by vitals, meters, holds

nk-style-hold.description: How a press-and-hold shows its progress

nk-style-focus.description: Focus on parts that are not rows (rows and buttons light like hover)

nk-style-vital.description: What a vital chip shows (expand: the tag opens on a change)

nk-style-vital-icon.description: Vital icons: each vital's own colour, or the chip's ink

nk-style-vital-neighbours.description: What a growing vital chip does to its neighbours

nk-style-pause.description: The pause menu: a full-height sheet, or a light slash panel

nk-behavior-alert.description: A level at or under this is an alert (vitals, durability)

nk-behavior-rest.description: How long a changed HUD part stays open before it retracts (0 = never)

nk-behavior-notify-info.description: How long an info notice stays

nk-behavior-notify-success.description: How long a success notice stays

nk-behavior-notify-danger.description: How long a danger notice stays

nk-hue-glow.description: A role's glow (under the glow budget)

nk-layer-dim.description: Stacking layer: dim (a modal is the current surface + dim + dialog)

nk-layer-dialog.description: Stacking layer: dialog (a modal is the current surface + dim + dialog)

nk-time-snap.description: A press, a rim switching state (0.5d)

nk-time-fast.description: Hover, a face rising, a deny beat (0.667d)

nk-time-base.description: Panel enter, the selection, tab switch (d)

nk-time-slow.description: Sheets, dialogs, a glyph landing, toasts, a confirm pop (1.556d)

nk-time-fill.description: A level filling or draining; HUD show-on-change (2.333d)

nk-ease-exit.description: Exits and things tucking away (speeds up as it leaves)

nk-ease-move.description: On-screen moves: the selection, FLIP, a tab underline

nk-ease-expand.description: Things opening and growing; full-screen enter

nk-ease-spring.description: An overshoot without a spring (confirm pops, press release)

nk-spring-snap.description: Spring: selection, tab underline, needle catch-up

nk-spring-move.description: Spring: toasts in, FLIP reflow, drawers, digit roll

nk-spring-soft.description: Spring: full-screen content, large frame changes

nk-stagger-max.description: Total cap: items past the cap enter together

nk-gesture-lift.description: A row's content and a slot sliding in on focus

nk-gesture-rise.description: How far things rise as they enter

nk-gesture-land.description: The scale a glyph lands from

nk-gesture-press.description: The scale of a pressed row or button

nk-gesture-confirm.description: The short pop of a confirm

nk-plate-color.description: The plate colour (drawn at its material's opacity through its channels)

nk-plate-drop.description: The plate's drop: hard, no blur

nk-plate-bg.description: The plate as drawn: its colour at the menu material's alpha

nk-fill-tint.description: The soft tint: an outline button's hover, a row sweep

nk-fill-alert.description: The bar at or under behavior.alert

nk-fill-height.description: A level bar's thickness: fills, meters, gauge tracks

nk-accent-paint.description: An active glyph's face, the speedometer's level, the compass N (a colour or a gradient)

nk-gap-surface.description: Padding of a surface (dialog body, sheet column)

nk-line-focus.description: A text field's caret rim (and a checkbox's or switch's lit rim): the only focus line

nk-line-clip.description: clip-path of panels: the shape.cut chamfer, or none

nk-line-clip-sm.description: clip-path of chips, glyphs and buttons: half the chamfer

nk-line-glow.description: Blur radius of a row's glow (a chip's is 0.75 of it, a meter's 0.625)

nk-depth-elevation.description: The box-shadow surface.elevation names (compileTheme writes the recipe)

nk-depth-text.description: The text-shadow hud.text names (compileTheme writes the recipe)

nk-alpha-day.description: 1 while day legibility applies (set by kit.css rules)

nk-restore-muted-foreground.description: muted-foreground, as the theme set it

nk-restore-background.description: background, as the theme set it

nk-screen-ratio.description: The content box's width / height (wider screens keep it, centred)

nk-screen-edge.description: A zone's distance from the safe area (1rem at 4:3, 1.25rem at 16:10)

nk-screen-scale-min.description: The rem floor as a fraction of the 1080p rem (720p and 4:3 stay readable)

nk-screen-area-l.description: The box's left inset from the screen

nk-screen-safe-x.description: A safe area inside the box, inline (TV overscan, a bezel)

nk-screen-safe-y.description: A safe area inside the box, block

nk-control-plate-color.description: The solid plate behind the face

nk-control-plate-x.description: How far the plate sits right of the face (0 = none)

nk-control-plate-y.description: How far the plate sits below the face (0 = none)

nk-control-plate-press.description: How far a held glyph presses toward its plate

nk-control-wall-height.description: How far the face sits above its wall (0 = flat; the primary button, the selection)

nk-control-wall-shade.description: How dark the wall is (the scrim over the face colour)

nk-control-face-ink.description: The legend's colour on the face

nk-control-face-skew.description: The face's slant (the box stays upright)

nk-control-face-shadow.description: The face's inner light and shade

nk-control-face-active.description: The face of an active glyph (the mic while talking, N on the compass, a checked box)

nk-control-face-hold.description: The hold fill over the face

nk-control-legend-pad.description: The italic overhang split to both sides

nk-control-legend-shift.description: A nudge for a leaning face

nk-control-tag-delay.description: The tag opens this long after the glyph lands

nk-control-primary-color.description: The keycap face under style.fill solid (the primary button, the lit row, the active tab)

nk-control-primary-tint.description: The face's opacity under style.fill soft

nk-control-primary-inset.description: How far the selection sits in from its item's sides (room for the skew)

nk-control-primary-lift.description: How far the face rises on hover and focus

nk-control-primary-press.description: How far a pressed keycap sinks, as a fraction of its wall

nk-control-primary-overhang.description: How far a row's selection reaches past its text

nk-panel-bg.description: The panel's fill: the surface at the menu material's alpha

nk-panel-shadow.description: The panel's drop: the elevation recipe

nk-panel-divider.description: The one hairline under a header

nk-panel-header-padding.description: Surface padding; the title a step off its hairline

nk-panel-footer-padding.description: On the panel itself, no rule above it

nk-panel-footer-rule.description: A rule above the footer (none: spacing separates it)

nk-row-gap.description: Between the icon, the text and the trail

nk-row-accent.description: The colour that marks the active row or slot (an outline, a hold ring)

nk-row-icon-box.description: The icon box beside the title (the icon inside is icon.md)

nk-list-gap.description: Between items: the wall plus breathing room

nk-list-pad-x.description: Inline padding: room for the tile's inset and skew

nk-field-marker-height.description: The marker the caret reads its box from: a line's height

nk-field-marker-drop.description: How far the marker sits below the baseline

nk-field-caret-blink.description: One breath of the caret at rest

nk-field-caret-blink-delay.description: How long the caret stays solid after typing or moving

nk-field-caret-blink-dim.description: The caret's opacity at the bottom of its breath

nk-field-mirror-rise.description: How far a typed character rises in

nk-form-field-label-gap.description: Between the name and its required mark

nk-form-field-label-leading.description: The label's line height over a control

nk-form-field-label-leading-row.description: The label's line height beside a control (checkbox, switch)

nk-form-field-end-gap.description: Between the reset button and the value

nk-form-field-row-gap.description: Between the control, the label and the hint on a row (checkbox, switch)

nk-form-field-row-height.description: A row's minimum height, so an icon-xs button never moves it

nk-form-field-trail-gap.description: Between the value and the control at a switch row's end

nk-form-field-control-affix-password.description: Room at a password field's end for the reveal button

nk-form-field-control-affix-stepper.description: Room at a number field's end for the inline stepper

nk-form-field-icon-inset.description: How far a text or number field's icon sits from its start

nk-form-field-icon-gap.description: Between a segmented control's icon and its first segment

nk-form-field-icon-pad.description: A text or number field's start padding when it has an icon

nk-form-field-stepper-inset.description: How far the inline stepper sits from the field's end

nk-form-field-reveal-inset.description: How far the password reveal button sits from the field's end

nk-form-field-meridiem-gap.description: Between the time segments and AM / PM

nk-form-field-meridiem-pad-x.description: The AM / PM button's inline padding

nk-form-field-meridiem-color.description: The AM / PM ink at rest

nk-form-field-clear-bleed.description: How far it reaches into the control's padding

nk-form-field-date-picker-bleed.description: How far it reaches into the control's padding

nk-form-field-date-picker-cell.description: A day, year or decade cell (the grid is seven cells wide)

nk-form-field-date-picker-gap.description: Between the popover's header and grid

nk-form-field-date-picker-step.description: Between the header's buttons and between year and decade cells

nk-form-field-swatch-inset.description: How far the preview swatch sits from the field's start

nk-form-field-swatch-pad.description: The colour field's start padding (room for the swatch)

nk-form-field-swatch-empty.description: The preview swatch while no colour is set

nk-form-field-description-indent.description: Its start inset under a checkbox row (aligned with the label)

nk-form-field-error-indent.description: Its start inset under a checkbox row (aligned with the label)

nk-stepper-delay.description: The first repeat of a held keycap

nk-dialog-shell-header-gap.description: Between the title and the description

nk-dialog-shell-footer-gap.description: Between the hints and the buttons

nk-dialog-shell-footer-bleed.description: How far the hints reach back into the padding (the first item's own inset lines up with the title)

nk-empty-state-gap.description: Between the header and the actions (panel size)

nk-empty-state-gap-screen.description: Between the header and the actions (screen size)

nk-empty-state-pad-screen.description: The screen size's padding, and the panel's from a medium viewport up

nk-empty-state-header-gap.description: Between the icon, the title and the description

nk-empty-state-icon-box.description: The icon's box (panel size, no glyph)

nk-empty-state-icon-box-screen.description: The icon's box (screen size, no glyph)

nk-empty-state-icon-ink-error.description: The icon's ink on an error

nk-empty-state-icon-tint-error.description: The icon box's fill on an error

nk-empty-state-title-size-screen.description: The title's size at screen size (the panel size takes the panel title)

nk-radial-menu-size.description: The wheel's diameter (the size prop overrides it)

nk-radial-menu-wedge-stroke.description: A wedge's rim, in the wheel's 100-unit drawing (the wedge path insets by the same amount)

nk-radial-menu-indicator-stroke.description: The lit wedge's rim, in drawing units

nk-radial-menu-item-width.description: An item's width, a share of the wheel

nk-radial-menu-item-gap.description: Between an item's icon and label

nk-radial-menu-label-size.description: An item's label and the centre's second line

nk-radial-menu-label-leading.description: An item's label and the centre's second line: their line height

nk-radial-menu-dot-size.description: The mark on an item that opens a submenu

nk-radial-menu-center-width.description: The centre button's width, a share of the wheel

nk-selection-tabs-list-gap.description: Between triggers: the selection never touches its neighbour

nk-selection-tabs-list-rest.description: Room under the triggers besides the selection's wall

nk-chip-hud-radius.description: A square HUD chip's radius (hotbar, target eye)

nk-chip-active-bg.description: An active chip's fill (rises from the bottom)

nk-vital-chip-size-sm.description: A small chip's box (telltales, compass marks)

nk-vital-chip-glyph-ratio.description: The face as a fraction of the box

nk-vital-chip-icon-ratio.description: The icon as a fraction of the face

nk-vital-chip-label-gap.description: Between the face and the tag's text

nk-vital-chip-pop-overlap.description: How far an open pop tucks behind the chip

nk-vital-chip-plate-drop.description: How far the wall drops straight below the face

nk-meter-segment-color.description: The gap's colour (the panel showing through)

nk-dial-disc-opacity.description: The disc's opacity under the arc

nk-level-hold-pad.description: The hold ring's thickness around a key

nk-level-fill-ink.description: An icon's copy over a solid fill (vital chips, HUD keys): dark on the fill

nk-slab-tone.description: The accent's channels (a screen sets it per state on any ancestor)

nk-slab-band-tint.description: The tone's alpha over the band

nk-slab-band-edge.description: The tone's alpha on its edges
